title: Checking a warranty
passage:
Is this tablet still covered by the warranty?
A. It's on the top shelf. B. I covered the screen with a cloth. C. Let me check the purchase date.
passageZh:
這台平板仍在保固範圍內嗎？
A. 它在最上層架子。
B. 我用布蓋住了螢幕。
C. 讓我查一下購買日期。
